verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only coarse capability scoping: tasks name their required tools, agents get tools via the mcps field, and delegation happens only 'when allowed'. That limits which tools an agent can reach, but the pack never describes fine-grained permissions or any sandbox. A competitor founder also says CrewAI lacks dial-able guardrails, which is an opinion rather than a concrete counter-example. Missing for 10: fine-grained per-tool permission/allow-deny policies, sandboxed or isolated code/tool execution, documentation of approval gates, independent hands-on corroboration.
